column1: # Harness base color, 8-bit sRGB. Slot 0 uses this color. Later slots
# multiply the channels by (100 + slot * 28) / 100, so a model stays
# inside its harness hue and gets lighter as the slot increases.
# Pinned model slots, 0 through 4. Names are matched in lowercase.
# An unpinned model uses a stable hash of its name into one of those slots.
# A provider prefix is ignored when the bare model id is pinned.
